verdict.rationale: Warp's own marketing says it offers 'Jobs that run on a schedule or when something happens. Defaults are on, and you can write your own,' which is a first-party claim of recurring and custom scheduled jobs. That is the only support, a single homepage line with no docs on how schedules are defined, what cadences are possible, or how jobs are managed. Shift scheduling and webhooks are separate features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: technical docs on defining and managing recurring schedules, details on schedule cadence and options, API or agent control of scheduled jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
